text: Flow logs confirm the good news first: the compromised account never reached anywhere else on the network. Containment was already won two lessons ago.
Eradication goes further than a password reset -- the account leaves its MFA exemption entirely, and its nightly sync moves to a certificate-bound managed identity that can't be phished the same way.

The corrected rule stops excluding by account tag and starts excluding only genuine non-interactive sign-ins from this account's own known automation app -- a real interactive sign-in is never excluded again.
A controlled test sign-in proves it: the exact shape of the attacker's sign-in now creates a Sentinel incident immediately, not thirty-six hours later.
Next: what Renata tells Oakmere's leadership, and what changes going forward.
